## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector positivity (8/11) versus pronounced large-cap divergences (many Big Tech names in RECOVERY while NVDA and several chips are BELOW TREND) — mixed signals support a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare lead: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%). Financials strong: V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%). Materials showing pockets of strength: APD ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%). Energy soft: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%). Communication/Telecom mixed with T BELOW TREND (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%), NOW RECOVERY (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), ADBE RECOVERY (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%), APD ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%), LRCX CORRECTION (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%), NUE BELOW TREND (1W: -11.09% | 1M: -14.38%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%). Weakness concentrated across Tech and Utilities.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +20.54%), NOW (1W: +18.77%), PANW (1W: +18.76%), ADBE (1W: +13.60%), AAPL (1W: +12.17%). Note major divergence: multiple large caps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN) are RECOVERY (1W up, 1M down) while several semis remain BELOW TREND — tactical, not broad-based.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/rotational: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), ADBE RECOVERY (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%). Sector breadth: Technology positive within the 8/11 overall but internals mixed; expect rotation within the sector.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%). Sector breadth: Financials are a clear source of leadership but watch for short-term profit-taking.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive leadership: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%). Sector breadth: Healthcare contributing to breadth and confirming the mixed/neutral market tone.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor rotation exposure to pockets of cyclicals/financials and select healthcare leaders while reducing exposure to narrow tech leadership concentration; treat large-cap Tech RECOVERY names as tactical opportunities rather than core drivers. Major divergence across Big Tech (multiple RECOVERY signals) argues for patience and tighter risk management.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%). BEARISH: QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%), LRCX CORRECTION (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (Sector performance strong; breadth supportive). BEARISH: Utilities and Energy (both 1W negative and hosting multiple BELOW TREND names).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch 1W resilience around recent lows as BELOW TREND (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) — a confirmed bounce would matter for growth sentiment. AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) — watch follow-through above near-term resistance for continuation. MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) — watch for consolidation breakout to validate payments-led strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ABT (+85): DOJ probe ends — ABT ABOVE TREND proxy not in key list, cross-ref price behavior shows sector corroboration (healthcare strength) — sentiment confirming sector strength. TGT (+80): full-year sales outlook raised — TGT not in detailed list but consumer staples showing positive 1W; sentiment likely confirming recent strength. NVS (+80): EC approval for SMA therapy — aligns with Healthcare leadership and likely confirms upside pressure.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-75): EU Android fine confirmed — GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.48%) — sentiment diverging from 1W bounce (distribution risk). ISRG (-50): below-consensus forecast — ISRG likely at risk; cross-ref shows price weakness confirming the negative headline. CAT (-45): headline on short interest/positioning — CAT CORRECTION (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) — sentiment confirms short-term exhaustion risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (no clear Growth vs Value dominance). PANW ABOVE TREND, MA ABOVE TREND and JNJ ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while multiple large-cap Tech names sit in RECOVERY and semis like QCOM remain BELOW TREND. Major divergence across Big Tech and concentrated leadership in Technology (4/5 top performers) is the key risk — monitor news-driven sentiment (GOOGL, ABT) for confirmation or distribution.
